en.t: What kind of behavior is this!

units.source_text: 太吉郎有点扫兴，就地站住了。

en.t: Taikichiro was a little disappointed and stopped right where he was.

units.source_text: 他们三人终于没有走进花丛。

en.t: In the end, the three of them did not walk into the flowers.

units.source_text: 其实，御宝的樱花，他们老早以前就很熟悉了。

en.t: Actually, they had been very familiar with the cherry blossoms at Miho since long ago.
